messages:
marie: FYI i ran into a bad privacy leak in the examples/cli flow. when validation fails we print the resolved config object and it contains the raw API key. reproducible locally and I think some staging Sentry events show it too.
samir: yikes. which example and which cli version?
marie: examples/quickstart-chat v1.4, cli 0.9.2. repro:
```
$ export RW_API_KEY=sk-test-abc123
$ export RW_ORG=acme-inc
$ node examples/quickstart-chat/index.js --env prod
Error: project missing
  at init (/app/index.js:58)
Config: { org: "acme-inc", project: undefined, apiKey: "sk-test-abc123" }
```
(i can see the same dump in staging Sentry)
olga: not great. that means anybody with access to our error logs could see live keys. is this limited to sample apps or could user apps hit it too?
marie: any app using the client lib with debug=true or calling logger.error(config) will print the object. the CLI also prints resolved config on some validation errors.
kevin: immediate mitigation: default to redacting known secrets in the logger. long term: pick canonical env var names and publish precedence rules + deprecation timeline for legacy names.
tia: agree on redaction. proposal: SDK/CLI auto-redact fields: ["apiKey", "token", "secret", "privateKey"]. provide explicit opt-in flag `--expose-config` for local dev only.
marie: canonical vars are all over the place (RW_API_KEY, RW_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY). can we standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT and accept legacy names with a warning for 90 days?
samir: canonical names sound good. one idea: allow a project-scoped env prefix like REDWOOD_<ORG>_<PROJECT>_API_KEY for multi-project CI, but that may be messy.
olga: prefer avoiding proliferation. keep canonical vars + explicit CLI flags (--org/--project) that override envs. document precedence: flags > project file > env > token default.
kevin: also need a recommended rotation story: promote ephemeral tokens via `rw auth login` which stores a short-lived refresh token locally and talks to a credential agent. for long-lived keys warn on creation and surface rotation docs in the console.
marie: immediate action items: 1) patch SDK logger to redact by default (P0), 2) CLI stop printing full config and add `--expose-config` gated behind env `DEV_EXPOSE_CONFIG=1` (P0), 3) docs PR to declare canonical env names + 90-day legacy passthrough (P1), 4) product/console note about rotation UX (P2).
kevin: i'll take the CLI change and open a draft PR in ~48h.
samir: i'll do the SDK redaction. quick Q: for structured logs should we keep the key with value `<redacted>` or drop the field completely?
tia: keep the field with `<redacted>` value and add an optional `redacted_fields` list to structured payloads to aid debugging without leaking secrets.
olga: i've set up a staging Sentry query to look for `sk-` patterns and object dumps. deploy-bot: created ticket RW-2345 assigned to @kevin/@samir. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Issue RW-2345 created: "Redact API keys in logs + standardize env vars" https://tracker.internal/RW-2345
marie: please message support/CS to rotate any staging keys that might have leaked and add an emergency rotation snippet to infra playbooks.
kevin: noted. will add changelog entry and link PR here when ready. thanks all :rocket:
